name: Kain Universal Sculpt Space Lab
tagline: A Node FFI + Three.js proof that Kain can drive a universal viewport and a Rust-powered WASM sculpt core.
summary: Localhost sculpt suite proof app: Node owns bundling and serving, Three.js owns the universal viewport, and a local Rust crate compiles to WebAssembly for brush deformation over a floating sculpt orb inside a giant void.
